input.summary: Make the cap mutual and Agreement-wide, set it at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and add mutual indirect/consequential exclusion plus carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and Agreement-wide and set the fee limb at fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, or USD 1,000,000 if greater, because as drafted only TrueLink is capped while Client's exposure under the Section 12(a) indemnity is unlimited. The short added sentences exclude indirect and consequential damages both ways, place confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirm Customer's payment obligations and all amounts due are not damages.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim AND (B) USD 1,000,000.

ops.text: THE FOREGOING LIMITATION SHALL NOT APPLY TO EITHER PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, OR ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. Customer's payment obligations, being Client's obligations to pay all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages.
